title: Upgrade readiness
intro: Deprecated and removed API versions that this cluster still uses, and version skew to resolve before upgrading Kubernetes.
clientsNote: This page sees stored objects and manifests, not clients that call deprecated APIs. To find those, check the API server's apiserver_requested_deprecated_apis metric before upgrading.
tableSource: The table of deprecations covers Kubernetes up to {{version}}, from the Kubernetes deprecation guide: {{url}}
